lines.text: You are on Mars. Gravity here is 3.71 metres per second squared - about 38 percent of Earth. Hold jump longer to go higher.
Dust storm rolling in. Visibility is dropping. Keep moving toward the light.
Release jump early for short hops; hold it to clear wide gaps.
Navigation Module recovered. Now we can find our way home.
That's one part. Mercury and Venus are waiting.
Long jumps need speed - run before you leap.
The storm passes quickly. Find cover or keep moving toward the beacon.
The lander wreck is ahead. You can make this jump.
